basis: Guidance ledger scores 5th-stream/Pottangi timeline credibility as low (guided volume cut 500->300->200kt within FY26; ~18-month historical guidance-slip pattern); DR1b (F-EXT-1150/1151) confirms commissioning UNCONFIRMED as of Jul-2026, past the guided date, with the commissioning-support tender still in pre-bid stage as of 01-Jul-2026

This assumption is the single largest source of estimate uncertainty in the model and is the key driver of the base-vs-bull EPS spread.
